stumbles.quote: Colours: mean ΔE76 0.07 vs a reference.
stumbles.why: The reference is never identified (a photo, a physical simulation, another renderer?), so the 0.07 figure can't be interpreted. ΔE76 is also jargon for many readers.

stumbles.quote: thick film sinks the way you tilt your phone
stumbles.why: Unclear whether it means gravity follows the phone's tilt via the accelerometer. It also sits oddly beside 'Untested on real phones', which makes it unclear how tilt was tested.

stumbles.quote: It drains at the border, goes black from the top, then pops.
stumbles.why: 'It' isn't defined. 'Goes black' is unexplained, because a reader may not know that very thin film looks black. It's also unclear whether this is a designed lifecycle or what the demo does.
This seems to conflict with the phone-tilt interaction as the main feature. It's unclear what was tested on, such as desktop with simulated tilt, and whether it works at all.

point: A WebGPU compute-shader soap film demo, where film thickness works as density and responds to phone tilt. It drains and pops, its colours were checked against an unnamed reference, and it hasn't been tried on real phones.
